limitations: 153 reserved CFPB test cases preserved within the expanded 900-case test split; the other 747 test cases were not evaluated.
Three product classes and nine allowed product/issue pairs; results do not cover other financial products.
Strict schema decoding enforces valid label pairs; validity alone does not establish accuracy.
Only the first 2,000 normalized characters are used. Priority, routing and summary are separate rules/extractive methods.
Fine-tuned locally from Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with the pc_kit QLoRA kit and exported to Q4_K_M; the larger 10-class 2026 test-set results are in pc_kit/results/qwen3-4b-main/eval/results.md.
On 300 rows of the 2026 test set the Q4_K_M export scored 59.7% (10-class) versus 64.7% for the unquantized adapter, so quantization costs some accuracy.
